save_fail.save_fail.title: Project not saved
save_fail.save_fail.kept: Your edits are still open here. Nothing is lost while the editor stays open.
save_fail.cause.full: The disk is full. Free up space or save the project to another drive.
save_fail.cause.denied: This folder or file is read-only, or you have no permission to write here. Choose another folder.
save_fail.cause.locked: The file is open in another program. Close it there, then press Retry.
save_fail.cause.missing: The folder no longer exists. Choose another folder, or restore it and press Retry.
save_fail.cause.offline: The drive or network folder is not available. Reconnect it and press Retry, or save elsewhere.
save_fail.cause.too_long: The file path is too long. Choose a shorter folder or file name.
save_fail.cause.other: The file could not be written: {detail}
